grid.expression: SELECT CAB.NUNOTA, CAB.NUMNOTA, CAB.DTNEG, CAB.DTENTSAI, CASE WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE IS NULL AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' THEN '-----' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' THEN 'Aprovada' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'D' THEN 'Denegada' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'E' THEN 'Aguardando Autorização' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'I' THEN 'Enviada' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'M' THEN 'Não é NF-e' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'P' THEN 'Pendente de Retorno' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'R' THEN 'Aguardando Correção' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'S' THEN 'Enviada EPEC' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'T' THEN 'NF-e Terceiro' WHEN CAB.STATUSNFE = 'V' THEN 'Com erro de Validação' ELSE 'Não Enviada' END AS STATUSNFE, CAB.CODTIPOPER, TPO.DESCROPER, PAR.CODPARC, PAR.NOMEPARC, PAR.IDENTINSCESTAD, CASE WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'R' THEN 'Revendedor' WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'C' THEN 'Consumidor Final' WHEN PAR.CLASSIFICMS = 'X' THEN 'Consumidor Contribuinte' ELSE '-----' END AS CLASSIFICMS, ITE.SEQUENCIA, ITE.CODPROD, (CASE WHEN PRO.USOPROD = '1' THEN 'Subproduto' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = '2' THEN 'Prod.Intermediário' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = '4' THEN 'Demonstração' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'B' THEN 'Brinde' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'C' THEN 'Consumo' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'D' THEN 'Revenda (por fórmula)' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'E' THEN 'Embalagem' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'F' THEN 'Brinde (NF)' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'I' THEN 'Imobilizado' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'M' THEN 'Matéria prima' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'O' THEN 'Outros insumos' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'P' THEN 'Em Processo' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'R' THEN 'Revenda' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'T' THEN 'Terceiros' WHEN PRO.USOPROD = 'V' THEN 'Venda (fabricação própria)' ELSE 'Cadastro incorreto' END) AS USOPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.QTDNEG, ITE.VLRUNIT, LIV.CODCFO, ITE.CODTRIB, ITE.ALIQICMS, ITE.CSTIPI, ITE.ALIQIPI, LIV.VLRCTB, LIV.OUTRASICMS, LIV.ISENTASICMS, LIV.OUTRASIPI, LIV.ISENTASIPI, (SELECT SUM(LIV1.VLRCTB - LIV.ICMSRETENCAO - LIV.VLRIPI) FROM TGFLIV LIV1 WHERE LIV1.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV1.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA) AS VLRITELIQ, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 1 AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),0) AS BASEICMS, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 1 AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),0) AS VLRICMS, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 3 AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),0) AS BASEIPI, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 3 AND DIN.CODINC IN (1,3,5)),0) AS VLRIPI, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 6),0) AS BASE_PIS, NVL((SELECT MAX(DIN.CST) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 6),0) AS CST_PIS, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 6),0) AS VLR_PIS, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASERED) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 7),0) AS BASE_COFINS, NVL((SELECT MAX(DIN.CST) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 7),0) AS CST_COFINS, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 7),0) AS VLR_COFINS, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.BASE) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 2),0) AS BASE_ST, NVL((SELECT MAX(DIN.ALIQUOTA) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 2),0) AS ALIQ_ST, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VALOR) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 2),0) AS VLR_ST, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VLRFCPINT) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 2),0) AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_ST, NVL((SELECT SUM(DIN.VLRFCPINT) FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CODIMP = 1),0) AS VLR_FEM_ICMS_OP, CID.NOMECID, UF.UF, CAB.CHAVENFE, (SELECT MAX(C.NUMNOTA) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS NUMNOTA_DEVOLUCAO, (SELECT MAX(I.VLRTOT) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFITE I, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRTOT_DEVOLUCAO, (SELECT MAX(I.BASEICMS) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFITE I, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRBCICMS_DEVOLUCAO, (SELECT MAX(I.VLRICMS) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFITE I, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRICMS_DEVOLUCAO, (SELECT MAX(I.BASEIPI) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFITE I, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRBCIPI_DEVOLUCAO, (SELECT MAX(I.VLRIPI) FROM TGFCAB C, TGFITE I, TGFVAR VAR WHERE C.NUNOTA = I.NUNOTA AND C.NUNOTA = VAR.NUNOTA AND I.SEQUENCIA = VAR.SEQUENCIA AND VAR.NUNOTAORIG = CAB.NUNOTA AND VAR.SEQUENCIAORIG = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND C.TIPMOV = 'D') AS VLRIPI_DEVOLUCAO FROM TGFCAB CAB, TGFITE ITE, TGFPRO PRO, TGFPAR PAR, TGFTOP TPO, TSICID CID, TSIUFS UF, TGFLIV LIV WHERE LIV.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND LIV.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND LIV.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER AND PAR.CODCID = CID.CODCID AND CID.UF = UF.CODUF AND TPO.ATUALLIVFIS <> 'N' AND (CAB.CODEMP = :P_CODEMP OR :P_CODEMP IS NULL) AND (CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI or :P_PERIODO.INI is null) AND (CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN or :P_PERIODO.FIN is null) AND (CAB.DTENTSAI >= :P_DTENTSAI.INI or :P_DTENTSAI.INI is null) AND (CAB.DTENTSAI <= :P_DTENTSAI.FIN or :P_DTENTSAI.FIN is null) AND (CAB.NUNOTA = :P_NUNOTA OR :P_NUNOTA IS NULL) AND (CAB.NUMNOTA = :P_NUMNOTA OR :P_NUMNOTA IS NULL) AND LIV.CODCFO >= :P_CODCFOPINI AND LIV.CODCFO <= :P_CODCFOPFIN AND (ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD OR :P_CODPROD IS NULL) AND (:P_CODTIPOPER IS NULL OR CAB.CODTIPOPER = :P_CODTIPOPER) AND (:P_UF IS NULL OR UF.CODUF = :P_UF)
